rule: one voice = one member = one fixed face; only the member whose voice is singing may lip-sync
style_base: cinematic cyberpunk K-pop music video still, rain-soaked neon city at night, volumetric haze, anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, high detail skin texture, film grain

NOVA.voice: A (main vocal: verse, pre-chorus, chorus, rap, bridge)
NOVA.role: the rescuer; runs through the city to reach ECHO
NOVA.look: Korean woman in her early twenties, K-pop idol, sharp jawline, confident intense dark-brown eyes with smoky black eyeliner, sleek chin-length silver-white bob with a vivid cyan underlayer, small silver ear cuffs, black matte techwear jacket with glowing cyan LED piping along the seams, black high collar

ECHO.role: the one trapped in a data capsule; her chant is the distress call; in the bridge her tears wake NOVA
ECHO.look: Korean woman in her early twenties, K-pop idol, soft gentle features, large luminous dark eyes, long straight black hair fading to magenta at the ends, delicate silver nose-bridge chain, white translucent high-collar outfit woven with glowing magenta fiber-optic threads

reference_sheet_prompt: Character reference portrait of {look}. Front-facing, head and shoulders, looking straight at the camera, neutral expression, even soft studio lighting with a subtle {signature_color} rim light, plain dark grey background, sharp focus, photorealistic, 85mm lens, no text, no watermark.
